full_judgment:
3. Short facts relevant for disposal of the Rule are that the opposite party as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 12 of 1995 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Koyra, Khulna praying for declaration of title to 2.69 acres contending, inter alia, that the suit property belonged to Tanungini Debi who verbally settled 6.29 acres of land fixing an annual rent of Taka 12,00 in favour of the plaintiff in Chittra 1350 BS. Before that settlement the suit property was a khal. That Khal was started to silted up and became fit for cultivation. After settlement the plaintiff got possession and paid rent. The RS record was prepared in the name of Tanungini Debi but thereafter, the suit property was recorded wrongly in the name of the Government in khas khatian No. 1. Neither the Government nor any heirs of Tanungini Debi had any possession in the suit land, In Baishak 1401 BS the local Tahsilder denied the title of the plaintiff and, as such, the suit for declaration of title. 

 4. The suit was contested by the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, being represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Khulna, by submitting a Written Statement denying the plaintiffs title and possession in the suit land and contending, inter alia, that the land measuring an area of 17.63 acre of SA Khatian No.1 and the land measuring an area of 4 acre appertaining to Plot No. 164 and an area of 29 decimal out of 2.98 acre was the Government khas land and was a khal. Now the suit land is being possessed by the public. The plaintiff had no title and possession in the suit land. With this defence the defendant prayed for dismissal of the suit. 

 7. The SA Khatian No.1 was marked as Exhibit 1. 6 Dakhilas issued from the Jamindary Estate was marked as Exhibit 2 series and the RS Khatian No. 75 was marked as Exhibit-3.
